fighters.name: Chameleon Skink Hornblower with Moonstone Club
Chameleon Skink Alpha with Moonstone Club

abilities.name: Agile Climbers
abilities.text: Until the end of this fighter's activation, do not count the vertical distance moved when this fighter is climbing.

abilities.name: Envenomed Weapons
abilities.text: Add 1 to the damage points allocated by each hit and critical hit from the next attack action made by this fighter this activation.

abilities.name: Hurled Bolas
abilities.text: Pick a visible enemy fighter within 8" of this fighter and roll a number of dice equal to the value of this ability.  If 1 of the dice scores a 6, that fighter makes 1 fewer action in this battle round (to a minimum of 0).  If a fighter is reduced to 0 actions in this way, that fighter cannot be activated in this battle round.

abilities.name: Bellow of the Carnosaur
abilities.text: Pick an enemy fighter within 6" of this fighter.  Until the end of the battle round, subtract 1 from the Move characteristic of that fighter (to a minimum of 1) and subtract 1 from the damage points allocated by each hit and critical hit from attack actions made by that fighter (to a minimum of 1).

abilities.name: Call of the Hunt
abilities.text: Pick a friendly fighter with the Hunters of Huanchi and Beast runemarks within 9" of this fighter.  That fighter makes a bonus move action.  Then pick a visible enemy fighter within 1" of the fighter that made the bonus move action and allocate a number of damage points to that fighter equal to the value of this ability.

abilities.name: Hit and Run
abilities.text: This fighter makes a bonus move action or a bonus disengage action, then this fighter makes a bonus attack action or a bonus move action.

abilities.name: Slippery
abilities.text: A fighter can make this reaction after they have been allocated the total damage points by a melee attack action. This fighter makes a bonus disengage action.

abilities.name: Hidden Hunters
abilities.text: After deployment, each player whose warband has this battle trait can pick a friendly fighter with this battle trait from each friendly battle group that is on the battlefield. One at a time, remove those fighters from the battlefield and pick a different battle group. Then deploy that fighter as if it were part of that battle group.
